title: Set Wi-Fi regulatory domain temporarily
summary: Set the regulatory domain to match your country to ensure correct channel availability and power limits. This is temporary until reboot.

steps.explain: Check the current regulatory domain. It might be '00' (world) or your country code.
Set the regulatory domain to your country code (e.g., US, DE, RU). Replace <COUNTRY_CODE> with the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

verify.expect: The output shows the country code you set.

rollback.explain: Reboot the system to revert to the default regulatory domain.

warnings: Misconfiguring the regulatory domain can cause interference or violate local laws. Use the correct code for your location.
